# Human Agent Co-Working

## Goal
Humans and agents should be able to work in the same workspace with shared:
- workstreams
- sessions
- graph context
- review surfaces
- approvals
- chronicle history

## Important behavior
- agents do not disappear into hidden loops
- humans can inspect or attach mid-flight
- reviews and handoffs are first-class
